items.quote: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left
items.claim: Moses spoke to Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar (his surviving sons)

items.quote: Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar
items.claim: Aaron and his sons were commanded to take and eat the remaining meat offering without leaven beside the altar

items.quote: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire
items.claim: Aaron and his sons were commanded to eat the meat offering in the holy place as their due portion
Moses affirms that he has been divinely commanded to give these instructions
